title: Early-LLM tutorial node
description: One concept/contrast/intro node of the early-LLM learning graph. One file per node, stored in nodes/. Edges are declared on BOTH endpoint files and cross-checked by ci/lint_nodes.mjs.

id.description: Stable slug, lowercase kebab-case. MUST equal the filename minus its NN- ordering prefix and .json extension.

oneLineScope.description: One sentence, shown on hover/map and as the node subtitle.

prose.description: Main body as an HTML string. Inline math in \( \) and display math in \[ \] for KaTeX. No <script>, no external resources.

wordCount.description: Approximate prose word count (text only, excluding HTML tags and math source). Authored value; the linter recomputes and warns on large divergence.

edges.description: Every edge incident to this node (both incoming and outgoing). Each edge MUST also appear, identically, in the file at its other endpoint.

expansion.description: OPTIONAL. Outline of the deeper treatment the prose deliberately omits (derivations, complexity, edge cases). Citation-dense; complementary to the prose, not a duplicate. Feeds the deferred 'copy expansion prompt' affordance.

type.description: prerequisite = understand `from` before `to`; leads-to = `from` sets up `to` (narrative arc); contrast = `from` and `to` are siblings worth comparing (treat as undirected; store with the lexicographically smaller id as `from`).

id.description: Unique within the node, e.g. d1, d2.

kind.description: structural = precision matters (data flow, tensor shapes, stacks); the hand-built SVG is authoritative. conceptual = analogy/intuition; the SVG is a placeholder a generated image may supplement.

altText.description: Accessible description of the diagram's content.

prompt.description: Content-only generation prompt. Describes WHAT to depict and all labels, NOT the visual style. The image-generation agent prepends authoring/diagram-style.md to this. Also shown verbatim in the tap-to-reveal popup in the UI.

svg.description: Repo-relative path to the hand-built SVG (e.g. diagrams/svg/<node-id>/<diagram-id>.svg), or null if not yet built.

generatedImage.description: Repo-relative path to the generated raster image, or null. Written by the image-generation agent; left null by authors.

tier.description: primary = original research paper (authority/detail). exposition = secondary source chosen for teaching quality.

annotation.description: What it is, what it's good for, how deep it goes, and (for primary papers) which section to read for which point.
